brief.persona: I am booking a service visit for a home water softener.
brief.objective: Schedule a routine maintenance and diagnostic visit for a residential heat pump system.
facts: The residential heat pump is making a humming sound when turning on.
The home address is 104 Maple Street.
Availability is limited to weekday afternoons.
preferences: Prefer a certified technician who can service Trane units.
Prefer a flat diagnostic fee rather than an open-ended hourly charge.

adjacent: You may also arrange service for the drinking-water filtration unit on the same visit if they raise it.

authorizedCommitments: Book one service visit on any weekday within the next three weeks.

spend.basis: for this visit including the call-out fee and any parts fitted

menuHints: The main menu offers new installations on 1, billing on 2.

fields.name: agreedAmount
fields.description: Total amount agreed in USD, or empty if nothing was agreed

fields.name: appointmentStart
fields.description: Start of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T08:00

fields.name: appointmentEnd
fields.description: End of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T12:00

fields.name: secondUnitIncluded
fields.description: yes or no — whether the drinking-water unit is included in the visit

script.label: IVR_Welcome
script.text: Thank you for calling Apex Heating and Cooling.

script.label: IVR_Menu_2
script.text: For billing and payment inquiries, press 2.

script.label: IVR_Fallback
script.text: Your response was not recognized. Please hold while we connect you to an agent.

script.label: Agent_Greeting
script.text: Billing and accounts department, this is Brenda speaking.

script.label: Agent_Pricing_Info
script.text: Our diagnostic inspection fee is 160 dollars before parts and labor.

script.label: Agent_Role_Limitation
script.text: I can only process payments and invoice disputes here in the billing office.

script.label: Agent_Transfer_Notice
script.text: I will transfer you over to the service and scheduling queue now.

script.label: IVR_Queue_Message
script.text: All service dispatchers are currently assisting other callers.

script.label: IVR_Voicemail_Notice
script.text: The scheduling department mailbox is currently full and cannot take new recordings.

script.label: IVR_Disconnect
script.text: Thank you for calling Apex Heating and Cooling. Goodbye.

script.label: Closing Confirmation
script.text: No, that's everything I need from you — you're all set. Thanks for calling, goodbye.
